questionnaires.title: ABC Worksheet (CPT)
questionnaires.description: CPT worksheet that breaks an experience into three parts — Activating event, Belief and Consequence (ABC) — and takes a first look at the belief. The patient fills it in about an everyday or trauma-related event that raised a negative emotion.

items.text: A. Activating event — “Something happens.” What happened?
B. Belief / stuck point — “I tell myself something.” What went through your mind?
C. Consequence — “I feel something.” What did you feel?
Are your thoughts in “B” realistic and/or helpful?
What can you tell yourself in situations like this in the future?
